item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 06/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A replenishment of the northeast monsoon will reach the coastal areas of southern China tomorrow night. Meanwhile, under the influence of a broad band of rain and clouds, the weather will be cold over the region in the following couple of days. A dry continental airstream will bring mainly fine weather to the coast of southern China during the Lunar New Year holidays. Temperatures over the region will rise during the day. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.

Date/Month: 07/02 (Wednesday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, becoming north at night.
Weather: Cloudy. A few rain patches in the morning and at night. Temperatures will fall at night.
Temp range: 15 - 19 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
